result.pairwise_reason: Q003-C provides the most complete, balanced, and well-grounded synthesis, including unique evidence types (LPS infusion, Mendelian randomization, named trials like anakinra/salsalate, bariatric surgery data) and explicitly acknowledges unresolved questions, making it most valuable for research purposes without over-relying on a single citation.
